baby.definition: A baby is a very young child, less than two years old, who has not yet learned how to speak.
baby.sentence: I used to be a baby but now I am an adult.

back.definition: The back is the rear part of something; it is the part in the other direction from the front.
back.sentence: I went to the back of the house.

background.definition: The background is what can be seen or heard behind other things that are closer or louder.
background.sentence: I was talking to Mary, but I heard the phone ringing in the background.

bad.definition: If something is bad, it is not good.
bad.sentence: Skipping school is a bad thing to do.

badly.sentence: Fingers so badly frozen they had to be amputated.

bag.definition: Bags are containers made of soft material like paper, plastic or leather.
bag.sentence: I put the garbage in a black plastic bag.

balance.definition: If something is in balance, it has equal amounts all around.
balance.sentence: She was walking on a thin line, but lost her balance and fell down.

ball.definition: A ball is a round thing. People often use them to play games.
ball.sentence: The croquet ball was hit through the wicket and the game was over.

ban.definition: If you ban someone, you disallow or block someone from doing something.

band.definition: A band is a group of people working together.
band.sentence: Those in the army who fought closely together in the war were called a band of brothers.

bank.definition: A building where you can keep and borrow money.
bank.sentence: I have to stop at the bank to deposit my check and get money for tonight.

barely.definition: If you can barely do something, you can do it only with great difficulty or effort.
barely.sentence: After the accident, she was barely able to stand.

barrier.definition: A barrier is something that stops passage; it does not allow anything to get through it.
barrier.sentence: The barrier across the road stopped traffic from getting past it.

base.definition: Something's base is its lower part; the solid part that touches the floor or touches the earth and keeps the other parts of the thing up.

basic.definition: When something is basic, it is simple.
basic.sentence: Everyone in the army has to have basic training.

basically.definition: You use basically to emphasize that what you are saying covers the most important parts of a topic, even if it's not 100% correct.
basically.sentence: So, you're basically saying that it was wrong to leave.

basis.definition: The basis of something, is the main ideas or parts that it is built on.
basis.sentence: On the basis of the information available, we have decided to cancel the project.

bath.definition: A long, high basin that you put water in and go in to wash your body.
bath.sentence: Jane put in water up to the top of the bath.

battle.definition: A battle is when different groups or teams fight each other.
battle.sentence: Grant won a decisive victory in the battle of Chattanooga.

be.definition: This verb tells us that a thing is present, or in a place.
be.sentence: The next meeting will be here.

beach.definition: A large area of sand (or very small stones), next to an area of water.

bear.definition: A bear is a big animal with a short tail. They either eat only meat or meat and plants. There are many different types of bears, for example brown bears and polar bears.

beat.definition: If you beat someone or something, you hit it, usually many times.
beat.sentence: It made a loud noise when he beat the drum.

beautiful.definition: If something is beautiful, it is very good to look at it.

beauty.definition: Beauty is the quality of being nice to look at.

become.definition: If x becomes y, it changes into y or changes to be more y.
become.sentence: The boy has become a man.

bed.definition: A piece of furniture to sleep on.
bed.sentence: At night, I go to bed.

bedroom.definition: A room in a house that is used for sleeping. This is where the bed is kept.

begin.definition: When you begin something, you start to do the first part of a longer action.
begin.sentence: You can not get to the end of any job before you begin.

behave.definition: How you behave is what you do or how you act.
behave.sentence: Why do you behave like that.

behavior.definition: Behavior refers to the way that you behave. That is, the kind of things you do.

behind.sentence: He was told he would get a kick on the behind if he kept being naughty.

belief.definition: A belief is an idea that is thought to be true.
belief.sentence: It is a widely accepted belief that the Earth revolves around the Sun.

believe.definition: When you believe, you have faith in something.
believe.sentence: I believe that the man told the truth.

bell.definition: A bell is an object that is shaped like a cup that makes a ringing sound when hit.

belong.definition: If x belongs to y, it is y's.
belong.sentence: What does it cost to belong to the library?

below.definition: In or to a place that is lower.

belt.definition: A belt is a piece of clothing worn around a person's waist. They can be used to hold up trousers or skirts, or for carrying things in pockets, such as on a utility belt.
belt.sentence: I think I've put on weight. My belt is too tight.

bend.definition: To change the shape of an object so that it is not straight.

beneath.definition: In or to a place that is lower.

benefit.definition: A benefit is something good that comes from something else.
benefit.sentence: It was her idea, but she received no benefit from the new program.

besides.sentence: I don't want to go to a restaurant; besides, we can't afford it.

bet.definition: When you bet, you take a chance with money or something else on the result of a future event.
bet.sentence: I bet five dollars that I would win the game.

between.sentence: Dancing all the dances with little rest between.

beyond.definition: Farther along in space or time or degree.

bias.definition: A bias is a preference in one direction that makes things unequal.
bias.sentence: They had plans for an international centre, with a strong political bias.

bid.definition: A bid is an offer to enter into a contract to buy something or to do some kind of job.
bid.sentence: She lost her bid at a world record fourth gold medal in swimming.

big.definition: If something is big, it is large in size; tall, wide, long, or fat.
big.sentence: I would like a big glass of milk.

bike.definition: A short form of bicycle or motorcycle.

bill.definition: A bill is a piece of paper money; a banknote.
bill.sentence: I paid for my sandwich using a twenty-dollar bill.

bin.definition: A bin is a container for garbage.
bin.sentence: Clean up this room and throw that junk in the bin.

bind.definition: If you bind something put rope or string around it, often many times.
bind.sentence: The Chinese would bind the feet of their women.

biological.definition: If something is biological, it is related to biology or life.

bird.definition: A bird is a warm-blooded animal that has feathers and wings and lays eggs. Most birds can fly.
bird.sentence: A sparrow is a bird and so is a penguin, even though it cannot fly.

birth.definition: A birth is when a new baby comes out of its mother.
birth.sentence: His election signaled the birth of a new age.

bit.definition: A bit is an amount, usually a small amount.
bit.sentence: There's quite a bit of money. Where did it all come from?

bite.definition: If a person or animal bites something, they put it between their teeth and squeeze.
bite.sentence: I'm afraid of dogs. I think they'll bite me.

black.definition: The darkest color; with no light; the color of the sky at night.
black.sentence: He stood away in the black of the night.

blame.definition: If you blame someone or something for something bad, you say or think that they are the reason for or cause of it.
blame.sentence: It's not your fault... don't blame yourself.

bless.definition: You say, bless you when someone sneezes.

blind.definition: If someone or something is blind, they can't see.
blind.sentence: I'm not totally blind. I can see a little.

block.definition: A block is a hard piece of material, usually with six smooth sides.
block.sentence: I could not start a page on Wikipedia because of a block.

blog.definition: A blog is a personal website that is used as an online journal (short for weblog).
blog.sentence: Check out my blog at blogwebsite.net.

blood.definition: Blood is a red liquid inside a person or animal's body that carries nutrients and oxygen to the other parts of the body.
blood.sentence: I'm taking medication for high blood pressure.

bloody.definition: You use bloody to emphasize what you're saying.

blow.definition: If wind, air, etc. blows, it moves.
blow.sentence: Can you blow that picture up a bit more? I can't see it clearly.

blue.definition: One of the colors people can see.
blue.sentence: The sky was a deep blue above her and golden yellow beyond the village.

board.definition: A board is a group of people who govern something.
board.sentence: The school board has chosen new textbooks for all the schools.

boat.definition: A boat is a vehicle used to travel on water.
boat.sentence: At the lake, the children learn about fishing and boat safety.

body.definition: A body is the main part of a person, animal, physical object, or organisation.
body.sentence: After falling out of the tree, his arm was broken and his body hurt all over.

bond.definition: A bond is a connection between two people because of love or friendship.
bond.sentence: The heat created a bond between the plastic and the metal.

bone.definition: Bones are the hard, white things inside your body. They give your body its shape.

book.definition: A book is a lot of paper joined together with writing and pictures printed on them for you to read or write in.
book.sentence: I am reading a good book on economics.

boom.definition: A boom is the sound that is made from an explosion.
boom.sentence: The boom of that volcano hurt my ears.

boost.definition: A boost is a push from behind.
boost.sentence: My friend gave me a boost to push me over the fence.

boot.definition: A shoe that covers part of the leg.
boot.sentence: He put his shopping bags in the boot.

border.definition: The border of a country is the edge of the country: the place where that country touches another country.
border.sentence: You can't cross the border without identification papers.

bore.definition: If you bore somebody, you make them feel that they want to do something else because it is not interesting.
bore.sentence: You need to bore a hole in the wood to put the wire through.

borrow.definition: If you borrow something from someone, you use it and then you give it back to them.
borrow.sentence: Governments need to make it easier for students to borrow money for school.

boss.definition: Your boss is the person who tells you what to do at work.
boss.sentence: My former boss was very happy for the chance to fire me.

both.definition: (used with count nouns) two considered together; the two.

bother.definition: If you bother to do something, you make an effort to do it.
bother.sentence: Don't bother with the dishes. I'll do them later.

bottle.definition: A bottle is a container, usually made of glass that holds liquid and has a cap or stopper.
bottle.sentence: He drank cold water from a plastic bottle.

bottom.definition: The bottom of something is its lowest part.
bottom.sentence: Lucy took a pen and wrote her name at the bottom of the page.

boundary.definition: A boundary is the line around something's outside edge.
boundary.sentence: The elephants have to live within the boundary of the park or risk being shot.

bowl.definition: A bowl is a deep dish.
bowl.sentence: In large mixing bowl, stir together flours, baking powder, and salt until thoroughly combined.

box.definition: A box is a square container, usually with four sides, a top and a bottom.
box.sentence: I gave my seat to an old woman with a chicken in a wooden box.

boy.definition: A boy is a male child or teenager; someone who is not a man yet.
boy.sentence: My oldest son was a Boy Scout in England.

brain.definition: Your brain is the part of your body that is inside your head.
brain.sentence: The brain is the part of the body that thinks and controls the rest of the body through the nervous system.

branch.definition: A part of a tree that grows out from the trunk (center).
branch.sentence: Sally scraped her arm on a branch when she fell out of a tree.

brand.definition: A brand is a red-hot piece of wood in a fire.

bread.definition: Bread is food made from mixing flour, water, and yeast.

break.definition: If you break something, you make it come apart in a way that cannot easily be put back together, usually by force.
break.sentence: These are the rules. Don't break the rules and I won't send you home.

breakfast.definition: Breakfast is the first meal that we eat in the morning.
breakfast.sentence: I'm late for school. I don't have time for breakfast today.

breath.definition: Your breath is the air that you move into and out of your lungs.
breath.sentence: After running for just a minute, his breath was coming quickly.

breathe.definition: If you breathe, you inhale and exhale air.
breathe.sentence: I can breathe better when the air is clean.

breed.definition: A breed can be a type of animal or plant; a species or race.
breed.sentence: This breed of dog likes to bark more than most.

bridge.definition: Anything which avoids something which blocks a path, usually water, by going over the top of it.
bridge.sentence: The Golden Gate Bridge connects the two sides of California.

brief.definition: If something is brief, it is for a short time.
brief.sentence: Today there will be brief periods of rain.

briefly.definition: If something is done briefly, it is done in a short time.

bright.definition: If something is bright it gives out or fills with much light.
bright.sentence: The sun is very bright during summer.

brilliant.definition: If something is brilliant, it gives off a lot of light.
brilliant.sentence: It was evening with the brilliant colors of sunset shining through the trees.

bring.definition: When you say "you bring" something to someone, you carry it with you to that someone.
bring.sentence: You bring lunch to me every day.

broad.definition: If something is broad, the distance from one side to the other is large.
broad.sentence: Her shoulders were swimmer's shoulders, strong and broad.

broadcast.definition: If you broadcast something, you make it widely known.
broadcast.sentence: My parents decided to broadcast my test scores to the entire family when they came over for dinner.

brother.definition: Your brother is another male child of one or both of your parents.
brother.sentence: Two sisters and their brother played in the park yesterday.

brown.definition: Brown is one of the colors people can see.

brush.definition: A brush is a tool with many thin pieces of plastic to smooth hair and wool.
brush.sentence: He gave his hair a quick brush.

budget.definition: A budget is a limit to how much money can be spent on something.
budget.sentence: The accountant made a new budget that showed us how much we would spend on materials.

build.definition: If you build something, you make it out of pieces of other things.
build.sentence: This is a new idea that others can build upon.

bunch.definition: If you have a bunch of something, you have many of them.
bunch.sentence: We had to try a bunch of times before we could start the car.

burn.definition: If something has been cooked too much, then it is burned.
burn.sentence: If you touch a hot pan of water, you can burn yourself.

burst.definition: If something bursts, it breaks open because of pressure from the inside.
burst.sentence: I was driving west on the highway, when my front left tire burst.

bury.definition: If you bury something, you put it into the ground and cover it.
bury.sentence: I tried to bury these unpleasant memories.

bus.definition: A bus is a vehicle that carries a large number of people on roads.
bus.sentence: He ran to catch the school bus, which had stopped at a corner to pick up more kids.

business.definition: Business is the buying and selling of things or services.
business.sentence: I am in the business of catching fish and selling them.

busy.definition: If you are busy, you are doing something and not available to do something else.
busy.sentence: I'm sorry, I'm busy on Monday. Can we get together on Wednesday?

but.sentence: There is but one sun and one earth to live on.

button.definition: A button is a round object that can be pushed through clothing so that the clothing stays on.
button.sentence: I pressed the button to turn on the television.

buy.definition: If you buy something, you give money and the thing becomes yours.
buy.sentence: Could you buy some milk at the store?

buyer.definition: A buyer is a person who buys items.

by.definition: So as to pass a given point.
by.sentence: Put something by for her old age.
